dosbox-pure.review: GPL combining/linking obligations remain subject to review

livius-chess-art.usage: Source-only SVG reference; current native-game renderer still uses independently authored flat-mesh glyphs. No SVG binaries from this directory packaged in APK.

lichess-chess-openings.usage: Offline textual ECO opening names and SAN histories; do not imply a classical game score or chess-engine evaluation.

release_policy.phone_test: Owner-affirmed eleven original songs are approved for all first-party ReverieVR APK builds as commercial-use-authorized without downstream CC/MIT grant. Include tracks only after matching source and staged SHA-256.
release_policy.public_commercial: Owner-original music is commercially authorized for ReverieVR APK distribution (not CC/MIT/CC0 relicensed); remaining third-party review-required/noncommercial assets still block a fully unrestricted open-content release.

source_notice_method: Android res/ binary files use explicit file-scoped REUSE.toml annotations; Android assets may use adjacent .license files; no sidecars within aapt2 res/ tree. Suno library index and approved audio tracks use per-file REUSE annotations.

owner_authorized_assets.name: Starry Cereal menu audio
owner_authorized_assets.notes: Project owner confirms Suno commercial rights for this specific track; permitted commercial use in the VR application's soundtrack, but no open-content sublicense or guaranteed copyright protection is asserted.
owner_authorized_assets.evidence: Owner declaration (2026-10-11); Suno Pro/Premier commercial-use terms https://suno.com/terms-of-service and https://help.suno.com/en/articles/9601665; transaction/download details are not published.

public_suno_catalog.status: only owner-approved officially downloaded tracks admitted to packaged library

music_import_policy.owner_original_exception: User-attested own original tracks in music/source/manifest.json use LicenseRef-Owner-Original-Music with SHA-256 and authorizing declaration rather than requiring Suno per-track URLs. No automatic open-content grant.
